#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Render a set of markdown files through a marmite binary, isolating content.html output.

Usage: mdrender.py <binary> <dir-with-md-files> <outdir>
Creates a temp site whose content.html template is exactly `{{ content.html }}`
so each generated <slug>.html is the raw rendered markdown body.
"""
import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile

def render(binary, mddir, outdir, extra_files=None, config=None, args=()):
    work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="mdr-")
    tdir = os.path.join(work, "templates")
    os.makedirs(tdir)
    with open(os.path.join(tdir, "content.html"), "w") as f:
        f.write("{{ content.html }}")
    with open(os.path.join(tdir, "list.html"), "w") as f:
        f.write("")
    with open(os.path.join(tdir, "group.html"), "w") as f:
        f.write("")
    for name in os.listdir(mddir):
        if name.endswith(".md"):
            shutil.copy(os.path.join(mddir, name), os.path.join(work, name))
    if config:
        with open(os.path.join(work, "marmite.yaml"), "w") as f:
            f.write(config)
    site = os.path.join(work, "_site")
    p = subprocess.run([binary, work, site, *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
    if os.path.isdir(site):
        for name in os.listdir(site):
            if name.endswith(".html") and name not in ("404.html",):
                shutil.copy(os.path.join(site, name), os.path.join(outdir, name))
    shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
    return p

if __name__ == "__main__":
    p = render(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
    if p.returncode != 0:
        sys.stderr.write(p.stdout + p.stderr)
        sys.exit(p.returncode)

Lines in a paragraph survive verbatim (with newlines) in the HTML, so output line i maps to candidate i. If the middle token is still `:N:` the shortcode is invalid; otherwise it converted and the token is the emoji. """ import os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile BIN = "/tmp/orig/marmite_ref" LINE_RE = re.compile(r"^q(\d+)q (.*) q\1q$") STATE = {"found": {}, "tested": set(), "calls": 0, "lines": 0} def _render_one(batch): work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="emj-", dir="/tmp/probe") tdir = os.path.join(work, "templates") os.makedirs(tdir) open(os.path.join(tdir, "content.html"), "w").write("{{ content.html }}") open(os.path.join(tdir, "list.html"), "w").write("") open(os.path.join(tdir, "group.html"), "w").write("") parts = ["---", "title: t", "slug: probe", "---", ""] for i, n in enumerate(batch): parts.append("q%dq :%s: q%dq" % (i, n, i)) open(os.path.join(work, "probe.md"), "w").write("\n".join(parts) + "\n") site = os.path.join(work, "_site") p = subprocess.run([BIN, work, site], capture_output=True, text=True) out = os.path.join(site, "probe.html") if not os.path.exists(out): shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True) raise SystemExit("render failed rc=%s\n%s\n%s" % (p.returncode, p.stdout[-3000:], p.stderr[-3000:])) html = open(out).read() shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True) return html def probe(names, chunk=200000, quiet=False): """Test candidate names; returns dict of newly-found name -> emoji.""" todo, seen = [], set() for n in names: if n and n not in seen and n not in STATE["tested"]: seen.add(n) todo.append(n) new = {} for start in range(0, len(todo), chunk): batch = todo[start:start + chunk] html = _render_one(batch) body = html.strip() assert body.startswith("

") and body.endswith("

"), body[:200] lines = body[3:-4].split("\n") assert len(lines) == len(batch), "line mismatch %d vs %d" % (len(lines), len(batch)) for line, name in zip(lines, batch): m = LINE_RE.match(line) if not m: raise SystemExit("unparsable line for %r: %r" % (name, line)) val = m.group(2) if val != ":%s:" % name: new[name] = val STATE["calls"] += 1 STATE["lines"] += len(batch) STATE["tested"].update(todo) STATE["found"].update(new) if not quiet: print("probed %d new cands (%d total tested) -> %d hits (%d total found)" % (len(todo), len(STATE["tested"]), len(new), len(STATE["found"])), flush=True) return new def cps(s): return " ".join("U+%04X" % ord(c) for c in s)

"""Phase 2: combinatorial brute force over word vocabularies."""
import re, sys, unicodedata, itertools, json

import probe

def load_prev():
    try:
        for line in open("/tmp/probe/emoji/found.tsv"):
            p = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
            probe.STATE["found"][p[0]] = p[1]
            probe.STATE["tested"].add(p[0])
    except FileNotFoundError:
        pass

def save():
    with open("/tmp/probe/emoji/found.tsv", "w") as f:
        for k, v in sorted(probe.STATE["found"].items()):
            f.write("%s\t%s\t%s\n" % (k, v, probe.cps(v)))
    json.dump(sorted(probe.STATE["tested"]), open("/tmp/probe/emoji/tested.json", "w"))

JUNK = re.compile(r"hangul|braille|kangxi|cjk|ideograph|katakana|hiragana|bopomofo|"
                  r"radical|tibetan|khmer|myanmar|dingbat|canadian|syllabic")

def uni_vocab():
    v = set()
    for a, b in [(0x00A0, 0x00FF), (0x2000, 0x33FF), (0x1F000, 0x1FBFF)]:
        for cp in range(a, b + 1):
            try:
                nm = unicodedata.name(chr(cp))
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if JUNK.search(nm.lower()):
                continue
            for w in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9]+", nm):
                v.add(w.lower())
    return v

def hit_vocab():
    v = set()
    for k in probe.STATE["found"]:
        for w in k.split("_"):
            if w:
                v.add(w)
    return v

def main():
    load_prev()
    UV = uni_vocab()
    print("uni vocab", len(UV))

    probe.probe("%s_%s" % (a, b) for a, b in itertools.product(sorted(HV), sorted(UV)))
